title: tms-phosphene-perception: code, pre-registration and frozen detectors for 'TMS-evoked phosphenes carry the EEG signature of natural visual awareness'
description: Code, pre-registration documents (with git tags dated before each analysis), frozen EEG detectors and result tables for the paper. A detector of natural near-threshold seeing is trained on OpenNeuro ds006171, frozen, checked on an independent natural-vision dataset and applied without retraining to TMS-evoked phosphenes over occipital and parietal cortex (GIN DB_123). Code under MIT; documentation, results and detectors under CC BY 4.0.
